source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if all(all(v == row[0] for v in row) for row in grid):
        known = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0]
        for p in range(1, h + 1):
            phases = {}
            valid = True
            for r, color in known:
                k = r % p
                if k in phases and phases[k] != color:
                    valid = False
                    break
                phases[k] = color
            if valid and len(phases) == p:
                motif = [phases[k] for k in range(p)]
                return [[motif[r % p] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
        raise ValueError('row clues do not determine a complete period')
    period = 6
    phases = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, color in enumerate(row):
            if color:
                phases[(r + c) % period] = color
    return [[phases[(r + c) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
